notes.title: Devlog for July 2025 - Marty McFly Voice Actor in FOOLISH MORTALS!
notes.notes:
[p]Our July devlog is up! End Credits, Interactive Song, and our [b]CAST REVEAL! [/b][url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inklingwood/foolish-mortals/posts/4394457"]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inklingwood/foolish-mortals/posts/4394457[/url]

Inklingwood Studios is thrilled to announce that acclaimed voice actor [b]AJ LoCascio[/b] is making a triumphant return to the world of point & click adventure games as protagonist [b]Murphy McCallan[/b] in the upcoming adventure game [i]Foolish Mortals[/i][b].[/b][/p][p]Adventure game fans will recognize AJ LoCascio from his breakout performance as [b]Marty McFly [/b]in [i]Back to the Future: The Game [/i]by Telltale Games. Since then, AJ has lent his voice to a range of iconic characters, including [b]Han Solo[/b] ([i]LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga[/i])[i], [/i][b]Gambit[/b] ([i]X-Men ’97[/i]), [b]Prince Lotor[/b][i] [/i]([i]Voltron: Legendary Defender[/i]), [b]Gizmo[/b] ([i]Gremlins: Secrets of the Mogwai[/i]), [b]Owen Grady[/b] ([i]Jurassic World Evolution[/i]), [b]Emmet Brickowski[/b] ([i]The LEGO Movie 4D: A New Adventure[/i]), [b]Henry[/b] ([i]Country Bear Musical Jamboree[/i] at Walt Disney World Resort), and [b]Figment[/b] ([i]Disney Speedstorm[/i]).[/p][p][b]Foolish Mortals[/b] is a full-length point & click adventure game set in the moody and mysterious world of 1930s Louisiana. Taking the role of a young treasure hunter arriving on the island of Devil's Rock, the player is in search of the lost treasure of Bellemore Manor, where thirty years before an entire wedding suddenly and mysteriously vanished. With a plethora of puzzles spanning more than 75 meticulously hand-drawn backgrounds, players are sure to get fully immersed in this ghostly world of the merry and the macabre.[/p][p]AJ is joined by a stellar line-up of voice talent from some of the most celebrated adventure games in recent years:[/p][p][b]Matt Curtis[/b] - [i]Crowns & Pawns, The Hand of Glory, Unforeseen Incidents[/i][/p][p][b]Andy Mack[/b] - [i]Whispers of a Machine, The Biggleboss Incident, Midnight Margo, The Will of Arthur Flabbington[/i][/p][p][b]Rhiannon Moushall[/b] - [i]The Drifter, Old Skies, Prim, 3 Minutes to Midnight[/i][/p][p][b]Phillip Sacramento[/b] - [i]Old Skies, The Excavation of Hob’s Barrow, BROK the InvestiGator[/i][/p][p][b]Will de Renzy-Martin[/b] - [i]Loco Motive[/i], [i]Old Skies[/i], [i]Prim, The Excavation of Hob’s Barrow[/i][/p][p]The cast also features 10-year-old [b]Robin Hardwidge[/b], son of [i]Lucy Dreaming [/i]and [i]Heir of the Dog [/i]creator Tom Hardwidge.[/p][p]Adding even more depth to the cast are celebrated actors from beyond the world of adventure games: [b]James Brown Jr.[/b], [b]Marilena Gant[/b], [b]Gerald Hill[/b], [b]Tara Langella[/b], and [b]Joey Sourlis [/b]take on the roles of ghostly gardeners, superstitious rumrunners, overconfident captains, and more, while [b]Mirabel Ukpabio [/b]provides her sultry singing voice in an interactive big band musical number.[/p][p]Voice direction and production were handled by [b]The Game Editors[/b], a boutique consulting studio helmed by Jess Haskins and Francisco González, bringing years of experience from his own adventure games, including [i]A Golden Wake, Shardlight, Lamplight City, [/i]and, most recently, the critically acclaimed [i]Rosewater. [/i]Thanks to their expertise, [i]Foolish Mortals[/i] has been officially approved as a Screen Actors Guild–American Federation of Television and Radio Artists (SAG-AFTRA) project.[/p][p][b]Foolish Mortals [/b]is set for release in [b]late 2025[/b], and is available to [b]wishlist now[/b] [b]on Steam[/b]: [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1848440/Foolish_Mortals/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: INKLINGWOOD STUDIOS joins forces with THE GAME EDITORS
notes.notes:
Press Release:

David and Sophie Younger, the husband-and-wife team behind INKLINGWOOD STUDIOS, are pleased to announce a new collaboration with another creative couple, established adventure game developers Francisco González and Jess Haskins of GRUNDISLAV GAMES and THE GAME EDITORS, to oversee voice production on Inklingwood’s upcoming point & click adventure game FOOLISH MORTALS. 

David Younger explains: [i]"When we produced the Foolish Mortals demo, I handled all aspects of voice production myself, including more than one thousand voice clip auditions! With only six characters, I just about managed, but I knew that there was an opportunity to go far more professional with the voice production in the full game. Thanks to the success of our Kickstarter, we've reached the point of casting an additional 30 characters, as well as re-recording all dialogue from the demo. I knew it was time to bring in a team with experience, and that is where Francisco and Jess come in!" [/i]

The Game Editors will oversee script editing, casting, recording and post-production on the fully voiced, full-length adventure game, transforming more than 75,000 words of dialogue into a living (and un-living) world inhabited by a fearsome phantom, a ghostly gardener, an inebriated ferryman, superstitious rumrunners and many more colorful characters. 

A family-run boutique consulting studio, The Game Editors provides narrative and editorial services alongside its newest offering, full-service voiceover production. FOOLISH MORTALS will be the team’s first external voiceover project.

Together, Haskins and González handle script editing and voice production for titles from González’s own studio, Grundislav Games. Their 2018 detective adventure Lamplight City was acclaimed for its voice acting. The duo raised the bar again for their upcoming Western adventure Rosewater, assembling a highly talented, star-studded cast of union voice actors with credits including Red Dead Redemption, Firewatch, and The Walking Dead.

[i]“We've always put an emphasis on fluid, expressive dialogue and nuanced performance in our projects,” Haskins says. “Finding amazing actors and getting to work with them in the recording booth is one of the most fun parts of the work! Now we’re taking the expertise we’ve honed on our own games over the years and using it to help others achieve that same high level of voiceover quality on an indie budget. We’re thrilled to be partnering with Inklingwood on Foolish Mortals to bring this fantastic cast of characters to life.”[/i]

Jess Haskins is a game editor, narrative designer and founder of The Game Editors. Her previous roles include writer and game designer on Guns of Icarus Online and creative director on Hiveswap. She has edited numerous games, including point & clicks Lamplight City, The Plague Doctor of Wippra and PRIM, idle adventure The Longing and tropical farm sim Coral Island.

Francisco González has been making adventure games using Adventure Game Studio and releasing them as Grundislav Games since 2001. After completing the eight-part Ben Jordan series of freeware adventures in 2012, he began making games professionally: A Golden Wake was published in 2014, followed by Shardlight in 2016 and Lamplight City in 2018.

David Younger continues: [i]"Francisco's Ben Jordan: Paranormal Investigator was an incredible source of inspiration to me as a teenager, when I first started pondering the creation of my own adventure games. It's taken me two decades to make the leap into actually doing it, but to now be working alongside Francisco would have blown my mind at the time." [/i]

FOOLISH MORTALS is a point & click graphic adventure game in which the player takes control of Murphy McCallan, a young treasure hunter arriving on the island of Devil's Rock in search of the lost treasure of Bellemore Manor, where 30 years ago an entire wedding suddenly and mysteriously vanished. With plenty of puzzles spanning more than 75 gorgeously hand-drawn backgrounds, players are sure to get fully immersed in this ghostly world of the merry and the macabre. 

FOOLISH MORTALS is due to be released later in 2024. The game can be wishlisted on Steam at https://store.steampowered.com/app/1848440/Foolish_Mortals/

notes.title: Foolish Mortals Kickstarter Ends TOMORROW!
notes.notes:
Hello ghosts! I just wanted to share that the Kickstarter for my merry & macabre point & click adventure game ends TOMORROW! 

Please take a look at it at [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inklingwood/foolish-mortals/]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inklingwood/foolish-mortals/[/url]

Over the last month, we've hit tons of stretch goals for bonus puzzles, music, backgrounds, and even an INTERACTIVE SONG PUZZLE like Curse of Monkey Island's "A Pirate I was Meant to Be"! 

We have a load of awesome rewards on offer too - from appearing in the game as a GHOST, to a 90s style BIG BOX packed with in-universe documents! Please take a look! 👻

notes.title: Foolish Mortals Demo Now Available!
notes.notes: The demo for Foolish Mortals is now released, and we can't wait for you to play it. We also want to hear your feedback so that we can apply it to the full game, and make the best possible Foolish Mortals we can. The demo is fully voiced in English, with subtitles in English, German, French, Italian, and Spanish, and includes an optional in-game hint system.
